cipher.summary: Added a shared circuit breaker to ProviderAdapterSeam's chat and image-generation calls and fixed Retry-After being incorrectly clamped to the same 30s cap as self-generated backoff.
cipher.risks: Breaker thresholds and the 10-minute Retry-After ceiling are judgment calls, not validated against live xAI traffic (no API key available in this environment); the breaker is a simplified two-state design without half-open trial-limiting by design.
